docFindings.doc: 124｜CodeEditor 与 Artifact Detail 交互详解.md
evidence: Doc diagram reduces detail to `Load --> Type{preview type}`, `Type -->|html/image| Preview`, `Type -->|binary| Download`.

Source `artifact-file-detail.tsx` has a write-file path (`write-file:` URL), draft result lookup via `findToolCallResult`, `.skill` files treated as markdown with install action, code/preview toggle, HTML preview through a Blob iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms"`, base href injection, and scroll-restoration postMessage handling.
Source `core/artifacts/loader.ts` appends `/SKILL.md` for `.skill` artifacts and can read write-file draft content from tool calls.
docFindings.issue: Missing runtime/state transition detail: the doc does not explain the most important artifact behaviors after cleanup: write-file draft preview, failed write disabling preview, `.skill` install path, HTML Blob iframe scroll restoration, and non-code iframe/download fallback. It is source-backed but too lossy for debugging artifact rendering.
docFindings.patch:
Append this section after the existing Mermaid block:

```md
## Artifact detail 运行态补充

- `write-file:` artifact 不走普通 artifact fetch；它从 URL 中解析 `message_id/tool_call_id`，再从当前 thread messages 找对应 tool result 或 draft content。
- `.skill` artifact 被当作 markdown 代码内容读取，实际 fetch 路径会补 `/SKILL.md`，并在非静态站点下显示安装按钮。
- HTML/Markdown 才支持 preview toggle；HTML preview 会注入 `<base>` 和滚动恢复脚本，生成 Blob URL 后放入 sandbox iframe。
- 非代码文件当前直接 iframe 打开 artifact URL；下载按钮通过 `?download=true` 打开新窗口。
```

And replace the diagram with a richer runtime diagram:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  ArtifactList --> SelectFile
  SelectFile --> Detail[ArtifactFileDetail]
  Detail --> IsWrite{filepath starts write-file:}
  IsWrite -->|yes| ToolCallDraft[find tool_call result or draft content]
  IsWrite -->|no| FetchArtifact[useArtifactContent]
  FetchArtifact --> SkillPath{ends .skill}
  SkillPath -->|yes| FetchSkillMd[append /SKILL.md]
  SkillPath -->|no| FetchRaw[artifact URL]
  ToolCallDraft --> ViewState[getArtifactViewState]
  FetchRaw --> ViewState
  FetchSkillMd --> ViewState
  ViewState -->|code mode| CodeEditor
  ViewState -->|markdown preview| StreamdownPreview
  ViewState -->|html preview| HtmlBlobIframe[base href + scroll restore + sandbox iframe]
  ViewState -->|non-code| RawIframe[artifact URL iframe]
  Detail --> Actions[copy/open/download/close]
  SkillPath --> InstallSkill[install skill action]
```

evidence: Doc diagram only shows `sendMessage --> optimistic`, `useStream --> mergeMessages`, history API and cache update.

Source `frontend/src/core/threads/hooks.ts` has important states/transitions: `onCreated` upserts busy thread and metadata; `onLangChainEvent` emits `onToolEnd`; `onUpdateEvent` handles summarization middleware messages and title cache updates; `onCustomEvent` handles `task_running` and `llm_retry`; `onError` clears optimistic/live state and invalidates token usage; `onFinish` invalidates thread and token-usage caches; `sendMessage` handles upload conversion, upload status, `hide_from_ui`, context flags (`thinking_enabled`, `is_plan_mode`, `subagent_enabled`, `reasoning_effort`) and `streamSubgraphs/streamResumable`.
docFindings.issue: Missing runtime diagram/state transitions. For this slice, `useThreadStream` is a high-risk UI/runtime adapter; the current doc omits upload, hidden optimistic messages, created/error/finish transitions, custom events, and context-mode mapping.
docFindings.patch:
Replace the Mermaid block with:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  ChatPage --> useThreadStream
  useThreadStream --> useThreadHistory[load historical run messages]
  useThreadStream --> useStream[LangGraph useStream]
  UserSubmit --> sendMessage
  sendMessage --> Baseline[pending usage baseline]
  sendMessage --> Optimistic{hide_from_ui?}
  Optimistic -->|no| HumanOptimistic[optimistic human message]
  Optimistic -->|yes| NoOptimistic[skip visible optimistic row]
  sendMessage --> Uploads{files?}
  Uploads -->|yes| UploadFiles[convert + upload files]
  UploadFiles --> UploadedKwargs[additional_kwargs.files uploaded]
  Uploads -->|no| Submit
  UploadedKwargs --> Submit
  Submit --> ContextFlags[thinking_enabled / is_plan_mode / subagent_enabled / reasoning_effort]
  ContextFlags --> LangGraphSubmit[thread.submit streamSubgraphs streamResumable]
  useStream --> OnCreated[onCreated upsert busy thread]
  useStream --> OnToolEnd[on_tool_end listener]
  useStream --> OnUpdate[onUpdate title + summarization handling]
  useStream --> OnCustom[task_running / llm_retry]
  useStream --> OnError[clear optimistic + invalidate token usage]
  useStream --> OnFinish[invalidate thread lists + token usage]
  useThreadHistory --> Merge[mergeMessages]
  useStream --> Merge
  HumanOptimistic --> Merge
```

Add a short note:

```md
`useThreadStream` 不只是 `useStream` 包装：它还承担 optimistic UI、文件上传、隐藏消息、mode 到运行上下文的映射、subtask/custom event 更新、错误清理和 React Query cache 失效。
```
